svg.text: 30 molecules, box split into thirds: how many microstates each macrostate owns
all 30 in the left third: 1 microstate
Shading is logarithmic: a hexagon at 9.74
owns a thousandth of the centre’s count.
Each hexagon is one macrostate (n1, n2, n3): the numbers of molecules in the left, middle and right thirds.
